units.text: Aspose.Cells FOSS for Rust reads and writes Excel .xlsx workbooks. It loads workbooks from files, byte arrays, or streams using Workbook.load_xlsx, Workbook.load_xlsx_from_bytes, and Workbook.load_xlsx_from_stream, and saves them using Workbook.save_xlsx, Workbook.save_xlsx_to_bytes, and Workbook.save_xlsx_to_stream. It provides methods to inspect and repair damaged packages via LoadOptions.try_repair_package, LoadOptions.try_repair_xml, and Workbook.get_load_diagnostics. It supports reading and writing cell values, formulas, styles, worksheets, charts, tables, validations, conditional formatting, sparklines, pictures, shapes, hyperlinks, auto-filters, and document properties.

It reads and writes .xlsx files from a path, a stream, or in-memory bytes, with repair options via LoadOptions.try_repair_package and LoadOptions.try_repair_xml, and exposes structured diagnostics through Workbook.get_load_diagnostics.

It reads typed cell values—string, double, boolean, and date-time—via Cell.get_string_value, Cell.get_double_value, Cell.get_bool_value, and Cell.get_date_time_value, and writes values and formulas with cached results through CellMut.put_value_string, CellMut.put_value_i32, CellMut.put_value_bool, CellMut.put_value_date_time, and CellMut.put_formula_with_cached_value.

It applies styling through CellStyle.font, CellStyle.fill, CellStyle.borders, CellStyle.number_format, CellStyle.horizontal_alignment, CellStyle.vertical_alignment, and CellStyle.wrap_text, with Font.set_color, Font.set_is_bold, Font.set_is_italic, and Font.set_underline for font-level control.

It manages worksheets by adding them with WorksheetsMut.add, renaming via Worksheet.set_name, controlling visibility with Worksheet.set_visibility_type, freezing and unfreezing panes with Worksheet.freeze_panes and Worksheet.unfreeze_panes, and sizing rows and columns through Worksheet.set_row_height and Worksheet.set_column_width, while protecting and unprotecting sheets via Worksheet.protect and Worksheet.unprotect.

It enforces data validation rules with ValidationCollection.add, Validation.set_type, and Validation.set_operator, and applies conditional formatting through ConditionalFormattingCollection.add, FormatCondition.set_type, and FormatCondition.set_style.

It creates charts with ChartCollection.add and Chart.chart_type, embeds pictures via PictureCollection.add, inserts drawing shapes with ShapeCollection.add, and builds sparkline groups using SparklineGroupCollection.add and SparklineGroup.sparkline_type.

It builds structured tables with ListObjectCollection.add and ListObject.show_totals, applies auto-filters via Worksheet.auto_filter, AutoFilter.set_range, AutoFilter.get_sort_state, and AutoFilterSortState.get_sort_conditions.

It reads and writes core document properties like DocumentProperties.get_author and DocumentProperties.set_title, extended properties such as ExtendedDocumentProperties.get_company, and manages workbook protection through Workbook.protection, WorkbookProtection.get_is_protected, Workbook.protect, and Workbook.unprotect.

The primary entry point is Workbook, which owns a Worksheets / WorksheetsMut collection of Worksheet objects. Each Worksheet exposes its cells through get_cells() / get_cells_mut(), returning a Cells / CellsMut accessor used for individual Cell / CellMut access, row/column collections, and merged ranges.
The Cell and CellMut types represent a single worksheet cell and expose value, formula, and style operations, with CellValue and CellValueType enumerations describing the cell's stored data.
The Cells and CellsMut types provide access to worksheet cells, rows, columns, and merged ranges, with CellArea identifying ranges and CellsMut.merge supporting range merging operations.
The CellStyle type represents a mutable cell style facade that can be applied to one or more cells, with Font, Fill, Borders, and Border types controlling font, pattern, and border formatting.
The Chart type represents a chart embedded in a worksheet, with ChartCollection managing charts on a worksheet and ChartType specifying the chart type.
The AutoFilter type represents auto filter, with AutoFilter.get_range, AutoFilter.set_range, and AutoFilter.get_sort_state methods managing filter ranges and sort state.

The ListObject type represents an Excel table (structured reference / ListObject), with ListObjectCollection managing tables on a worksheet and ListObject.show_totals controlling the totals row display.
The Picture type represents a picture (image) anchored to a worksheet, with PictureCollection managing pictures on a worksheet.
The Shape type represents a drawing object (auto shape) anchored to a worksheet, with ShapeCollection managing shapes on a worksheet.
The SparklineGroup type represents a sparkline group containing sparkline items that share type and settings, with SparklineGroupCollection managing sparkline groups on a worksheet.
The Hyperlink type represents a hyperlink, with HyperlinkCollection managing hyperlinks defined for a worksheet.
The DefinedName type represents a defined name, with DefinedNameCollection managing defined name objects for a workbook.
The Comment type represents a worksheet comment (legacy note) anchored to a single cell, with CommentCollection managing comments (legacy notes) on a worksheet.
Aspose.Cells FOSS for Rust reads and writes .xlsx (OOXML/SpreadsheetML) files and provides a Rust API for workbook and worksheet manipulation.

It supports only the .xlsx format for input and output, with no support for legacy .xls (BIFF), ODS, or CSV, and the public API surface is broad but not a complete match for Aspose.Cells — some features are still partial, and the crate is early-stage and evolving.
A workbook must always keep at least one worksheet: WorksheetsMut.remove_at returns a CellsError::Unsupported error when asked to remove the last remaining worksheet.
No automated test suite ships yet (cargo test --all-targets currently reports 0 tests).
The crate is not yet published to crates.io.
Installation requires a git dependency workaround.
The crate is early-stage and evolving.
CellObjectValue represents the type of value stored in a cell.
CellValue represents the actual data stored in a cell, such as a string, number, boolean, or decimal.
CellsError indicates an error condition encountered while processing cell data.
DateSystem specifies the date system used for date calculations in a workbook.
DiagnosticSeverity indicates the severity level of a diagnostic issue found during workbook loading.
HorizontalAlignment specifies the horizontal alignment of text within a cell.
VerticalAlignment specifies the vertical alignment of text within a cell.
